An munsahir's skin radiates heat like a forge's fire. A creature that starts its turn in the area must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or become fatigued while it remains in the area. Creatures immune to [environmental heat effects](/Rules.aspx?ID=642) or with any fire resistance are immune.
**[Reactive Strike](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=48)** --- **Speed** 20 feet **Melee** warhammer +14 ([Shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=193)), **Damage** 1d8+9 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire **Ranged** dueling pistol +12 ([Concealable](/Traits.aspx?ID=327), [Concussive](/Traits.aspx?ID=401), [fatal d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=178), [range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 1](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)), **Damage** 1d6+6 piercing plus 1d6 fire **Burning Touch** ([Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) The munsahir gatecrasher's Strikes deal an extra 1d6 fire damage (included above). When the gatecrasher successfully performs a [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) or [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=38) action, they also deal 1d6 fire damage to their target. **Volcanic Hammer** The trooper makes a warhammer Strike that deals one extra weapon die of damage and 2d6 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).
